name: excalidraw
title_zh: 先写规格再算字宽，手绘风图表一次成型的 Excali
tagline_zh: 受够了 AI 画的框图箭头乱飞、文字溢出色块、连线指错框？它先写一份短规格，再用真实字体度量算尺寸、排布局。
tagline_en: Tired of AI diagrams with arrows pointing nowhere and text spilling out of boxes? It writes a short spec.
desc_en: Use when producing a diagram as a .excalidraw file, or when asked for an architecture, flow, sequence, tree, mind map, org chart, timeline, network, ERD, swimlane, kanban or wireframe drawing that should look hand-drawn. Writes a short spec and expands it deterministically with measured font metrics, real layout and correct arrow bindings, then lints and renders it. Triggers on excalidraw, diagram
why_zh: 关键在「确定性展开」：布局和箭头绑定由代码算，不靠模型即兴摆坐标，所以同一个规格每次出图都一样。
why_en: Deterministic expansion: layout and arrow bindings are computed, not improvised, so the same spec renders the same diagram every.
limit_zh: 只产出 .excalidraw 文件，不导出 PNG/SVG，也不上传到 excalidraw.com；图元是矩形。
limit_en: Outputs .excalidraw files only — no PNG/SVG export, no upload. Shapes limited to rect/ellipse/diamond/text/arrow; no icon libraries or brush.
title_en: Hand-drawn Excalidraw diagrams from a short spec, measured.
